sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Lemis is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II.

sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: The first android made by Reeze, a scientist from Bectas who got into the field of technology thanks to her brother's influence. Lemis was build to have more physical endurance, knowledge of weapons, and capacity to adapt to any situation than the average human. Lacking in the area of ranged attacks, her strength lies in her ability to detect enemies rapidly, and then disposing of them with the same speed and efficacy through melee attacks. The fighting ability and expertise she gained while in use would prove to be an invaluable component passed down to Lilith, her younger sibling who was to be built later, a well as for the other androids and weapons Reeze and her brother would eventually make together.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content: - Lemis is the first humanoid weapon developed by Reeze
